title: High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine Catalogue Row
seoTitle: High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Sprayer | Pinjin 7 m³/h
description: Xingtai 380 V high-flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine lists dual copper motors 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m / 70 m and particle ≤8 mm for cement mortar, concrete or grout. It is not the 5 m³/h / 295 kg hydraulic sprayer, not M9 plaster and not a trailer concrete pump. Quote only.
primaryKeyword: high flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine

relatedPaths.label: High-flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine product page

answerBlock.what: This Xingtai high-flow hydraulic sprayer lists 380 V dual motors 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m / 70 m and particle ≤8 mm for cement mortar, concrete or grout, 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm, 650 kg. It is not the 5 m³/h / 295 kg hydraulic sprayer, not M9 plaster, not a diesel sprayer and not a trailer concrete pump. Quote only.
answerBlock.who: Contractors matching 7 m³/h, ≤8 mm particle and longer listed hose distance to a spraying job whose hose stays inside 150 m / 70 m.
factors: Printed materials: cement mortar, concrete, grout
Output 7 m³/h and pressure 8 MPa
Hose 38/51 mm and 150 m / 70 m
380 V for the listed 11/15 kW dual motors

faqs.question: Is the 7 m³/h unit a substitute for the compact 5 m³/h sprayer on constrained floors?
faqs.answer: No. The compact hydraulic sprayer lists 295 kg and 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm. This high-flow row lists 650 kg and 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm.

faqs.question: Is M9 the same as this high-flow sprayer?
faqs.answer: No. M9 is plaster at 30 L/min, 50 bar, 25 mm hose, particle ≤4 mm and 200 kg.
